PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, reviewed_by null); no human reviewed or tested anything, no hardware was attached or run, and no hardware or sim-engine run is claimed.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD (shape, not decision or helper): the card is family-config with GymnasiumDriver, but that bridge cannot publish this wrapper's contract. GrootRoboCasaEnv's Dict action space keys already start with 'action.' (gymnasium_groot.py:66, robocasa/models/robots/__init__.py:229-240) and unmap_action reads those exact keys (:402-410). The gymnasium bridge prefixes every Dict key with 'action.' when it derives limits, building the unresolvable path 'action.action.left_arm'; 'python3 -m mhs.driver reference' fails with 'limit path action.action.left_arm does not resolve in the input schema'. Minimal SDK repro: any GymnasiumDriver whose fake Dict action space has a dotted key such as 'action.x' fails the same way; nesting or escaping dotted Dict keys when building the derived limit paths would fix it. The package is therefore a direct Driver over the card's first entry symbol, GrootRoboCasaEnv, with MHS input names without the upstream prefix and a driver-side translation back to 'action.<part>' before the native step; no upstream syntax was changed and the SDK was not edited.

WHAT IT SERVES: one environment, g1_unified/EvalPnPAppleToPlate_G1ArmsAndWaistDex31Hands_Env (test_env.py:17), the G1 arms-and-waist robot with Dex31 hands. cap.world.step.v1 takes ticks plus the five part arrays left_hand 7, right_hand 7, left_arm 7, right_arm 7 and waist 3 (lengths from the repository example, test_env.py:25-33; the live dimensions come from the robosuite controller configuration and are not in this clone), every element bounded -1..1 from the converter's Box(low=-1, high=1) (robocasa/models/robots/__init__.py:236-238). cap.world.reset.v1 calls GrootRoboCasaEnv.reset(seed, options) and cap.world.seed.v1 records the seed for the next reset (the wrapper has no separate seed method, so it makes no native call; that is the one expected warning). ticks 1..10000 and seed >= 0 are the catalogue class schemas.

RISK/STOP: R1 (simulation stepping, MHS/spec/04-safety.md:67), above the card's R0 floor. No physical arm or base is actuated and there is no hardware backend or physical e-stop path; none is claimed. The @estop closes the environment and the runtime latches; no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch and the @reset hook reopens it at the recorded seed, and the observation and tick stay readable.

WHY A FAKE / FIDELITY: robosuite_g1, MuJoCo, gymnasium and the tabletop assets (README.md:29-42) are not installed where the gate runs, and package code never imports the clone. backends['fake'] is the package's pure Python F0 stand-in (.fake:FakeGrootRoboCasaEnv) for reset/step/close; it integrates a placeholder low-pass update of the five part arrays, returns reward 0.0 and terminated/truncated False (mirroring ignore_done=True at gymnasium_basic.py:69 and truncated=False at :256), and returns 2x2x3 placeholder frames for the four video.* keys where the observation space declares 256x256x3 (gymnasium_groot.py:20,29-30) and the cameras capture 1280x800 (robocasa/models/robots/__init__.py:374). The state and action lengths follow the repository example and are placeholders for the live controller dimensions. The fake was never compared with the upstream environment. No sim or hardware backend is declared; the real wrapper path needs robocasa imported to register the gym id, robosuite_g1, MuJoCo and the tabletop assets, and was not run.

NOT COVERED: MuJoCo/robosuite rigid-body dynamics, controllers, contacts, task success/reward, the real camera images, rendering, the other G1/GR1 robot aliases and tasks, and any physical device. Snapshot/restore is not offered (GrootRoboCasaEnv exposes no get_state/set_state). Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue_requests and no site-limits.example.json (no operator-required bound).

WARNINGS: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 only (expected: the seed is recorded for the next reset and makes no native call). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. TESTS: test_driver.py keeps check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') and adds seven cases (action envelope, step and Groot keys, seeded reset repeat, seed class, reset options, fidelity contract, e-stop latch and reopen); they pass. gate.digest is the digest line of the last CLI gate run; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
